method: REAL Playwright keyboard keydown/keyup events for every tile step; BFS only selects the legal path against the SAME runtime collision predicate. No camera-as-route, no teleport-as-route, no zoom, no stretched sprites.
scope: ISOLATED U05 CREATOR SELECTOR / AUDITION ONLY — not full Gameplay runtime integration, not visual acceptance, not 81 POI production art.

approachPlan.note: Legal tile resolution uses the SAME runtime collision predicate as real WASD input. It is path SELECTION, not a teleport, not a camera route and not a Gameplay law.

beforeAfter.note: Same 640x360 1x camera, same player tile, physical layer toggled OFF then ON. GOLD terrain/road untouched.

walkOut.note: Real keyboard steps out of the roof until the runtime reports roofHiddenCount()==0; roof is therefore visible in the capture.

collision.spawnFixtureNote: QA fixture positions the player at the wall-adjacent probe tile ONLY; the blocking attempt itself is real keyboard input.
